messages:
emma: Heads up 1: console customers are reporting meter discrepancies after we rolled key-router:v5. Project-level quota looks lower but SA owners claim nothing changed. Suspect attribution flip.
raja: Can you dump a couple of log lines showing both X-Origin-Project and X-Effective-Identity?
emma: sample log:
```
ts=2023-11-03T14:02:12Z origin=proj-404 X-Effective-Identity=sa:ingest-01 route=key-router:v5 tokens=32 status=200
```
lucy: That shows router honored EID. Our dashboard widgets still only surface origin which explains visual inconsistency.
tony: From a product perspective we promised project-level meters historically. If router starts preferring EID we need a controlled migration, otherwise support tickets explode.
raja: Suggest we do a twin-stream approach in telemetry: write events to topics `quota.project` and `quota.identity` simultaneously. Quota service reads `quota.identity` only when feature flag `enforce_by_eid`=on for that tenant. Console keeps showing project by default and we add a preview toggle.
emma: Agree. Also need to ensure the metrics store keeps both tags so historical backfills possible. Add tests that confirm for every request we emit both tags in the row: origin_project and effective_identity.
lucy: UX idea: add a subtle badge on quota card: "Attribution: PROJECT (preview EID enforcement)" with a diff modal showing expected change if flip applied. Make it opt-in per-project first.
tony: Ops: pilot on sandbox and 10% of Dedicated customers. Also add a safety cutoff: if any project's projected delta > 5% during the pilot, auto-disable the flag for that project and open a ticket to billing.
raja: I'll scope the pipeline dup emit (ETA 12h) and a reconciliation job SQL:
```
SELECT origin_project, effective_identity, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY origin_project, effective_identity
ORDER BY origin_project, tokens desc;
```
Run this to compute per-project deltas.
emma: Can someone mock console pill + modal so we can show PM before engineering?
lucy: I'll throw together a quick mock and post screenshots.
metric-bot: Note: key-router:v5 canary paused by emma at 14:10 UTC.
raja: I'll add a feature flag gate in quota service that can be toggled per-tenant and instrument an alert when project vs identity remaining quota diverge >2% for same project.
tony: Add migration runbook: how to backfill seven days for preview, customer comms template, rollback steps. We should coordinate with support.
emma: Owners: raja (pipeline + recon + flag), lucy (console mock + docs), tony (runbook + support comms). Post PR links here and tag billing if deltas look material.
raja: ETA initial PR + recon CSV: 10h. Will update thread.
emma: Thanks. Leaving thread open until pilot metrics are in.
